notification_policy.batch: wake-causing messages first, then unread; at most 8 messages / 6500 JSON characters
notification_policy.dispatch: next scheduler interval; one in-flight request per defender
notification_policy.loops: no self-wakes, no automatic replies, deduplicate by message ID and recipient
notification_policy.quota: existing shared decision and cost allowance; no renewal
notification_policy.receipt: successful provider response; failed/unknown requests retain pending IDs
notification_policy.retry: next scheduler interval, each attempt consumes a decision; no SDK retries
